content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Idaho Falls

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a specific combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus three years of project leadership, or a high school diploma plus five years—to confirm you meet the foundation for certification.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® preparation course delivered nationwide. Complete all 35 required contact hours on a schedule that fits your professional demands, with active certified practitioners leading real-world case studies and exam-aligned content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your training hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the associated PMI exam fee and await approval of your application before you can schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor guidance to build confidence. Schedule your exam when ready and complete the computer-based test within the PMI testing window to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, commit to a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, and continuing education to keep your PMP® active and demonstrate sustained expertise to employers across Idaho Falls's largest industries.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
